summary: Patient Access turns a WhatsApp 'Hi', a desk walk-in or a web visit into a confirmed booking, one token and an honest wait range, and keeps every desk, doctor screen, lobby TV and patient in sync within seconds. It covers the booking rules engine (auto, review or hybrid per visit type; slot or token sessions; walk-in interleave; solo mode), the integrity fixes that must land before real patient data (no double booking, no double check-in, compare-and-set queue moves, sessions that cross midnight), the ETA engine built from real consult timings with display modes, leave-home alerts and delay/no-show/waitlist automation, SSE live queue and lobby display, the Patient Access Edge (WhatsApp bot flows, branded booking site and widget, patient web, aggregator) and the gated Expo app. 60 stories in 12 epics, 469.0 engineer-days in total, against 424 tracker days for the 48 in-scope tasks (Areas Booking, Queue & ETA, Front desk, Aggregator, Patient app) plus 113 days for 9 closely-coupled WhatsApp/real-time/ETA tasks this domain also delivers (T-091, T-094, T-120, T-162, T-164, T-165, T-166, T-177, T-189), i.e. 537 tracker days overall.

stories.title: Check-in refuses an appointment dated another day, and doctor delays stay bounded to the clinic day
stories.story: As a receptionist I want check-in to refuse an appointment that is not for today and delay announcements to stay sane, so that I cannot put the wrong patient in today's queue or leave a stale delay running for days.
stories.context: QA-07: QueueService.checkIn only checks status, patient and doctor, so an appointment booked for next week can be checked in today and later marked completed. stories.title: Queue moves are compare-and-set, so two screens can never push a visit through the wrong steps
stories.story: As a doctor I want each queue move to apply only if the visit is still where my screen thinks it is, so that a stale screen or a double tap never skips vitals or billing.

stories.title: An appointment can be checked in only once and then shows 'arrived'
stories.story: As a receptionist I want the system to refuse a second check-in of the same appointment and mark it 'arrived', so that one patient never gets two tokens and an appointment cannot be cancelled while the patient is in the consult room.
stories.context: QA-06 (S2, clinical safety): the same appointment can be checked in twice, including by two receptionists at once, giving two tokens and risking notes on the wrong visit (H-03). The appointment stays 'scheduled', so it can be cancelled or rescheduled mid-visit and the slot is re-offered to the waitlist. QA-08: transfer() leaves the original appointment 'scheduled' forever. Fix (MF-29): add 'arrived' to appointments.status; inside the existing per-doctor-day advisory lock, check-in runs UPDATE appointments SET status='arrived' WHERE id=? Existing duplicate rows (from before the fix) are flagged legacy_duplicate rather than deleted, because notes or invoices may point at them. Also replaces the 32-bit hashtext advisory key with a two-key lock (T-201, MF-80) and wires the Idempotency-Key filter (MF-26) on check-in.

stories.title: Overlapping or invalid bookings are impossible, and each refusal says why
stories.story: As a receptionist I want the system to block overlapping bookings and bookings on leave, outside hours, off the slot grid or in the past, with a specific reason, so that two patients never share a slot and I know what to fix.

stories.title: Evening sessions that cross midnight stay one clinic day, and doctors can take part-day leave
stories.story: As a doctor I want my 20:00-01:00 session to be one session and to block just an afternoon off, so that my calendar matches reality and the queue does not reset at midnight.
stories.context: QA-22 / MF-54: queue_date is the calendar date at check-in and doctor_working_hours requires end_time > start_time, so a Gulf clinic running to 01:00 gets two queues at midnight: tokens restart at 1, GET /v1/queue defaults to the new date so everyone checked in before midnight disappears from the board, walk-ins after midnight skip the session cap and day close for 'yesterday' breaks. Doctor leave (V4) is whole-day only. Fix: a session-based clinic day with a configurable day start per tenant (default 04:00): ClinicClock.clinicDate(tenant, instant) = local date of (instant - dayStart). Every 'today' in scheduling, visit and the day close uses clinicDate. Working hours may end after midnight (end_time < start_time means next calendar day, and must end before the day start). ScheduleGrid works in minutes from the clinic-day start so 00:30 is minute 1470 and shows as '00:30 (+1)'. doctor_leave gains optional start_time/end_time for part-day leave inside one clinic day. Depends on T-060 (injected java.time.Clock). Ramadan schedules are R4 (T-271).

stories.title: Patients are told automatically when staff move, cancel or block their booking, with the nearest alternatives
stories.story: As a patient I want a WhatsApp message with the change and two or three alternative times whenever the clinic moves or cancels my booking, so that I do not turn up for a slot that no longer exists.
stories.context: FRD RCP-09, DOC-03, SYS-04: when the desk reschedules or cancels, or a doctor adds leave, the affected patients must get the change automatically with the nearest alternatives, and the receptionist must not type free text. Today addLeave only returns names of package patients and does not flag existing bookings (V4 'ponytail' note). Design: staff reschedule/cancel publish events with the coded reason; the Edge turns them into utility templates (sent by comms-gateway, PHI-minimised). New leave lists affected bookings on the desk; each row shows the three nearest valid alternatives (same doctor first, then same-specialty doctors if the owner allows). One tap 'Offer alternatives' (per row or all) records an offer and the patient gets buttons; tapping one books it through the internal API (409 -> next alternative is re-offered) and cancels the old booking with reason clinic_initiated. Patients without WhatsApp consent go to the callback list (NB-116) instead.

stories.title: Bookings are auto-confirmed, held for review, or routed by visit type in under 2 seconds
stories.story: As a patient I want my booking either confirmed straight away or clearly marked as 'we will confirm within 10 minutes', so that I know where I stand without phoning the clinic.

stories.title: Core exposes an internal booking API that only the Patient Access Edge can call
stories.story: As the Patient Access Edge I need a narrow, authenticated internal API on Core for availability, booking, check-in, lookups and ETA, so that patient channels can act without ever touching Core's database.
stories.context: ADR-01 and D6: the Edge is contract-only, with its own database and no Core table grants; it writes only through Core /internal/v1 with mTLS, aud=internal and an Idempotency-Key. This story builds that surface in Core: a separate filter chain (T-111 separates issuers and keys), service identity per Edge deployment, tenant in the path checked against the Edge's allowed tenants, Idempotency-Key mandatory on every POST (T-031 filter), and patient references that are opaque per-tenant tokens rather than raw ids. Endpoints: availability, booking requests (ACC-009), appointment confirm/reschedule/cancel, check-ins (ACC-033), household lookup by phone hash, patient create/complete (ACC-043), waitlist (ACC-027) and ETA (ACC-017). The audit actor is recorded as 'patient via edge' with the patient reference. It unblocks every patient-facing channel.
acceptance: Given a request without a client certificate or with aud other than internal, then 401
Given a POST without Idempotency-Key, then 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED; a replay with the same key returns the identical status and body
Given an Edge identity not allowed for tenant X, then any /internal/v1/tenants/X/... call returns 403
Given the ArchUnit and database grant checks, then the Edge role has no grants on Core tables and Core has no compile dependency on Edge code
Given a booking through the internal API, then write p95 < 400 ms and the audit row names actor 'patient via edge'
Given the OpenAPI contract, then Edge consumer contract tests (Pact) pass in CI on every Core change
